name: Program Append
summary: Adversaries may execute a program append to a PLC to update parts of an existing program. It may or may not require stopping the PLC which may allow it to continue running during transfer and reconfiguration without interruption to process control. Adversaries may leverage this approach to minimize downtime and evade detection. analytics.name: Analytic 2057
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol session adding new program blocks or routines to an existing controller program without replacing existing logic, from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, correlated against the device's program inventory showing a size increase without a corresponding planned update.
